macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks end mixed after strong jobs report
items.summary: The Dow fell 0.46% to 51,285.73, while the S&P 500 rose 0.31% to 7,376.86 and the Nasdaq gained 1.09% to 24,579.42. Chip stocks rebounded after a severe AI-led sell-off, but concerns about AI valuations and data-center restrictions continued to weigh on sentiment.

items.title: U.S. payrolls exceed expectations, unemployment rate falls
items.summary: Employers added 165,000 jobs in October, well above forecasts near 65,000-70,000, while unemployment declined to 4.1%. The data pushed Treasury yields and the dollar higher and strengthened expectations for a December Federal Reserve rate increase.

items.title: Markets increase bets on a December Fed rate hike
items.summary: Strong labor-market data lifted the implied probability of a 25-basis-point December rate increase to roughly 76%-80%. San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said further tightening could be necessary but emphasized that policymakers need more information and should proceed cautiously.

items.title: AI and semiconductor stocks rebound after sharp sell-off
items.summary: The Nasdaq rose 1.09% as chipmakers recovered, including AMD, Intel, Micron and Nvidia. The rebound followed a 5.5% Nasdaq plunge on Thursday amid concerns about stretched AI valuations, debt-financed investment and possible restrictions on data-center construction.

items.title: European governments prepare to choose next ECB president
items.summary: European governments are expected to select between Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos and the Netherlands’ Klaas Knot to succeed Christine Lagarde as president of the European Central Bank.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: GOPAX suspends trading and withdrawals after hacking threat
items.summary: South Korean cryptocurrency exchange GOPAX halted trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a reported hacking threat, while manual withdrawals remain available through customer support.

items.title: Crypto market capitalization edges lower as liquidations reach $709 million
items.summary: The global crypto market cap fell 0.2% to about $2.647 trillion. Bitcoin slipped 0.1% to roughly $75,958, Ethereum gained 0.3% to $2,246, XRP declined 4.2% to $1.16, and leveraged liquidations totaled approximately $709 million.

items.title: China investigates halted Solana event in Shanghai
items.summary: Chinese authorities said they stopped Solana-related advertising and offline communications in Shanghai and will investigate the organizations and individuals involved, reiterating that domestic virtual-currency business activities are illegal.

items.title: Standard Chartered and SBI invest in crypto insurer Soter
items.summary: Standard Chartered’s SC Ventures and Japan’s SBI Group participated in a roughly $66 million Series B financing for Soter Insure, which provides coverage for crypto-asset losses and plans to expand underwriting capacity.

items.title: Hyperliquid token falls below $80 after U.S. futures application
items.summary: Hyperliquid’s HYPE token dropped nearly 9% and fell below $80 after the platform applied to register as a U.S. futures commission merchant.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Cyber for automated vulnerability research
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model designed to find vulnerabilities, create working exploits, and suggest patches. The company says it identified 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, built exploits for 948, and disclosed 304 critical findings with patches.

items.title: Anthropic’s AI development pace raises safety concerns
items.summary: A METR report says Anthropic completed training three unreleased models over roughly six months, prompting researchers to warn that AI systems may increasingly accelerate the development of successor models and complicate safety oversight.

items.title: Baidu releases 280-billion-parameter ERNIE open-weights model
items.summary: Baidu reportedly released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model with 280 billion total parameters, adding to the expanding open-weights ecosystem.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model
items.summary: Google DeepMind reportedly launched an updated video-generation and editing model supporting clips up to 15 seconds, reference-based control, conversational editing, multi-speaker lip synchronization, and lower 720p pricing.

items.title: Meta acquires coding-agent orchestration startup Conductor
items.summary: Meta reportedly acquired Conductor, a startup whose software lets engineers run multiple coding agents side by side in separate project copies, reflecting growing competition around agentic software development.

items.title: Researchers demonstrate AI self-training without human-generated data
items.summary: Researchers from Tel Aviv University and Stanford developed a method allowing AI systems to teach one another and improve predictive performance without relying on human-generated content or external datasets.

items.title: AGIBOT unveils GO-3 Preview embodied AI model
items.summary: AGIBOT reportedly introduced GO-3 Preview, an embodied foundation model combining pre-training, post-training, and post-deployment learning, and claimed leading results on three embodied-AI benchmarks.

items.title: Figure signals larger-scale robot foundation-model training
items.summary: Figure CEO Brett Adcock said the company trained a new robotics model using its largest pretraining dataset and GPU deployment to date, tested it in a darkened house, and is training an even larger model expected within weeks.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass November Wave 1 adds 13 games
items.summary: Microsoft announced the first November 2026 Xbox Game Pass lineup, headlined by Football Manager 27 and spanning Xbox, PC, and cloud platforms.

items.title: Microsoft redesigns Xbox PC and cloud apps
items.summary: Microsoft introduced a redesigned Xbox app with faster launch times, quicker page loading, and simplified navigation; the update is rolling out to Xbox Insiders.

items.title: The Elder Scrolls VI confirmed as Sentinel
items.summary: Bethesda confirmed the subtitle The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel and revealed Hammerfell as the game’s setting, while withholding further release details.

items.title: EA releases 25 classic PC games on Steam
items.summary: Electronic Arts launched 25 classic PC titles on Steam, including seven restored anniversary editions.

items.title: Escape Academy 2 launches worldwide
items.summary: Coin Crew Games and iam8bit released Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School globally, with the puzzle game joining Xbox Game Pass on day one.

items.title: Ubisoft reportedly bids for Arkane Studios
items.summary: Ubisoft has reportedly submitted an offer to acquire Arkane Studios from Microsoft, alongside at least two other interested parties and a possible management buyout.

items.title: PIF and Silver Lake reportedly target Unity
items.summary: Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund and Silver Lake are reportedly discussing a potential acquisition of Unity Software at an estimated valuation of about $25 billion, though no agreement has been reached.

items.title: Mass Effect composer releases re-scored N7 Day trailer
items.summary: Composer Sam Hulick released a re-scored Mass Effect trailer for N7 Day and said he had previously worked on an internal Mass Effect: Universe demo before BioWare’s closure ended the project.

items.title: Don’t Be Afraid 2 launches on consoles
items.summary: Horror game Don’t Be Afraid 2: Escape the Nightmare became available on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5.
